summary: Completed public-URL API and browser testing. Health, seeded auth, patient registration, availability, hold/confirm, appointment listing, clinical notes, admin creation/overview, role denial, dashboard navigation, logout, and mobile overflow were exercised. One booking validation test failed: holds are accepted on doctor leave dates.

critical.issue: Accepts a patient hold for a doctor/date that is explicitly blocked by /api/admin/doctors/{doctor_id}/leave (live response 200 with HELD). The hold handler checks only past time and existing records; it does not validate doctor schedule, leave, or that the requested slot is an availability slot.

minor.issue: Authorization allows any authenticated doctor to cancel an appointment; unlike detail and clinical-note routes, it does not require the doctor to own the appointment.

The non-unique holds index plus check-then-insert is not a durable concurrency guarantee, even though the two-request smoke test returned 200/409 in this run; use an atomic/unique active-slot strategy.

integration_issues.flow: Patient find care, booking, and appointment confirmation
integration_issues.issue: Patient dashboard only changes the heading when Find Care/Appointments tabs are clicked; no doctor search, date/availability picker, hold countdown, symptom intake, confirmation, or cancellation controls are rendered.

Admin doctors/appointments and doctor today/patients tabs render the same generic dashboard content; there is no doctor creation, leave management, patient list, or clinical-notes UI despite backend endpoints existing.

action_items: Validate hold doctor, requested slot schedule, leave records, and current availability server-side before inserting a hold.
Make active holds/bookings atomic so concurrent requests cannot both hold the same doctor/start slot.
Restrict cancellation to the appointment patient, owning doctor, or authorized admin.
Implement the missing patient booking/symptom flow and admin/doctor management screens, or explicitly narrow the MVP scope.
critical_code_review_comments: The implementation does not match docs/system-design.md: leave creation does not detect future appointment conflicts or queue conflict work, and the hold path does not validate schedule/leave.
All dashboard nav items share one rendering branch, so navigation is cosmetic and core role workflows are inaccessible from the frontend.

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6 regression tests; leave-date hold test failed)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed patient/doctor accounts, appointments, holds, and one leave record through public APIs; no seeded accounts were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core API and auth/dashboard smoke tests pass. Start with the failing leave-date hold regression, then retest patient booking UI, doctor clinical workflow, admin management, and cancellation ownership.
rca of the issue: POST /api/admin/doctors/{doctor_id}/leave successfully writes db.leaves, and availability returns no slots for that date. POST /api/appointments/hold independently checks only start > now plus existing appointment/active hold; it never queries db.leaves or validates the doctor/date/time against availability. Therefore a manually supplied slot on leave is inserted as HELD.
